summary.zh: 把论文和报告压缩成要点并提取引用
summary.en: Condense papers and reports into briefs with citations

description.zh: 把论文、文章和报告压缩成简短摘要，对比多份材料并抽取引用条目。适合要快速读完一批文献，或为写作收集证据时使用。需要本地 Python 环境运行配套脚本。
description.en: Condenses papers, articles and reports into a short brief, compares several sources and pulls out citations. Use it to catch up on reading or gather evidence for a write-up. Runs on local Python scripts.
